title: Image Analysis
description: Allows analyzing image content, detecting noise with adjustable sensitivity, and removing it when needed.

title: Crop
description: Allows cropping the image manually or using automatic fit crop to remove unwanted margins.

title: Brush
description: Allows drawing raster strokes over the image with adjustable size and optional erasing.

title: Pencil
description: Allows drawing precise strokes without loss of sharpness.

title: Rectangle
description: Allows inserting a rectangle with adjustable fill, stroke, and opacity.

title: Ellipse
description: Allows inserting an ellipse with adjustable size, fill, and stroke.

title: Line
description: Allows drawing a straight line with adjustable thickness, color, and opacity.

title: Select
description: Allows selecting, moving, duplicating, or deleting objects, including multi-selection.

title: Resize
description: Allows changing image dimensions with optional aspect ratio locking.

title: Rotate
description: Allows rotating the image by predefined angles.

title: Flip
description: Allows flipping the image horizontally or vertically.

title: Grayscale
description: Allows converting the image to grayscale using selectable algorithms.

title: Background Removal (Automatic)
description: Allows automatically detecting and removing the background.

title: Background Removal (Manual)
description: Allows manually marking areas to keep or remove.

title: Background Removal (Color)
description: Allows removing the background based on a selected color range with adjustable tolerance.

title: Blur Area
description: Allows applying blur to a selected area with adjustable intensity and edge fade.

title: Text
description: Allows inserting and editing text with configurable font, size, color, and opacity.

title: Magnify Area
description: Allows zooming a selected area with adjustable radius, zoom factor, and outline.

title: Frame
description: Allows adding visual frames such as borders, browser windows, or device mockups.

title: Create Template
description: Allows saving the current set of operations as a reusable template.

title: My Templates
description: Allows applying a saved template to reuse the same adjustments.
